English: Characterization of the untreated tannery wastewater revealed that the mean concentration of BOD5, COD, TSS, PO4-P, TP, NO3-N, TN and total chromium were 1641±373.6, 6953.33±339.4, 1868±863.1, 88.06 ±40.8, 144.53 ±20.8, 116.66 ±26.6, 650.33 ±93.6 and 18.33±6.7 mg/l respectively beyond the permissible limits.
Luganda: Okwekenneenya amazzi ga kazambi agava mu makolero g’amaliba kwalaga nti okutwaliza awamu obungi bwa BOD5, COD, TSS, PO4-P, TP, NO3-N, TN ne total chromium bwali 1641±373.6, 6953.33±339.4, 1868±863.1, 88.06 ±40.8, 144.53 ±20.8, 116.66 ±26.6, 650.33 ±93.6 ne 18.33±6.7 mg/l mu busengeke obwo nga busukka ekkomo erikkirizibwa.
Yoruba: Àbùdá omi ìdọ̀tí awọ fi hàn pé ẹ̀dá ara BOD5, COD, TSS, PO4-P, TP, NO3-N, TN jẹ́ ààbọ̀ àti àpapọ̀ chromium sì jẹ́ 1641±373.6, 6953.33±339.4, 1868±863.1, 88.06 ±40.8, 144.53 ±20.8, 116.66 ±26.6, 650.33 ±93.6 and 18.33±6.7 mg/l lọ́lọ́kàn-ò-jọ̀kan tayọ ẹ̀dá ara tó pọ̀.
Zulu: Ukubonakaliswa kwamanzi angcolile ezimboni zesikhumba kuveze ukuthi ukushuba kwe-BOD5, COD, TSS, PO4-P, TP, NO3-N, TN kanye ne-chromium ephelele kwakungu-1641±373.6, 6953.33±339.4, 1868±863.1, 88.06 ±40.8, 144.53 ±20.8, 116.66 ±26.6, 650.33 ±93.6 no-18.33±6.7 mg/l ngokulandelana ngaphezu kwemikhawulo evumelekile.
Hausa: Halayen dauɗar ruwa da ba a kula da su ba ya nuna cewa yawan adadi na BOD5, COD, TSS, PO4-P, TP, NO3-N, TN da jimlar chromium su ne 1641±373.6, 6953.33±339.4, 1868±863.1, 88.06 ±40.8, 144.53 ±20.8, 116.66 ±26.6, 650.33 ±93.6 da 18.33±6.7 mg/l bi-da-bi fiye da iyaka da aka ƙyale.
Northern Sotho: Tlhathollo ya lefelo la go šogela mekgopha ya meetse a ditšhila ao a sa hlwekišwago e utollotše gore motswakotia ya fasana ya BOD5, COD, TSS, PO4-P, TP, NO3-N, TN gomme palomoka ya khromiamo e bile 1641±373.6, 6953.33±339.4, 1868±863.1, 88.06 ±40.8, 144.53 ±20.8, 116.66 ±26.6, 650.33 ±93.6 le 18.33±6.7 mg/l ka go latelana go feta ditekanyo tše di dumelegago.
Amharic: ያልታከመ የቆዳ ፋብሪካ ቆሻሻ ፍሳሽ እንደሚያሳየው የ BOD5፣ COD፣ TSS፣ PO4-P፣ TP፣ NO3-N፣ TN እና አጠቃላይ ክረሮሚየም ከሚፈቀደው ገደብ በላይ በቅደም ተከተል 1641±373.6፣ 6953.33±339.4፣ 1868±863.1፣ 88.06 ±40.8፣ 144.53 ±20.8፣ 116.66 ±26.6፣ 650.33 ±93.6 እና 18.33±6.7 ሚግ/ሊ ነበሩ።

English: The maximum removal efficiency of the constructed wetland in pumice bed revealed that BOD5 at HRT 7and 9 days (96.42%, 96.30%), COD at HRT 5 and 7 days (96.76%, 96.91%), NO3-N at HRT 5 and 7 days (99.99%, 99.68%), TN (98.67%, 99.00%), PO4-P HRT 7and 9 days (96.97%,100%), TP at HRT 5 and 7 days (94.79%, 96.17%) and total Chromium at HRT 5 and 7 days (98.36%, 98.91%) respectively.
Luganda: Obusobozi bw’okuggyamu obucaafu obw’olutobozi olukoleddwa mu pumice bwalaga nti BOD5 ku HRT ennaku 7 ne 9 (96.42%, 96.30%), COD ku HRT ennaku 5 7 (96.76%, 96.91%), NO3-N ku HRT 5 ennaku 7 (99.99%, 99.68%), TN (98.67%, 99.00%), PO4-P HRT ennaku 7 ne 9 (96.97%,100%), TP ku HRT ennaku 5 ne 7 (94.79%, 96.17%) ne total Chromium ku HRT ennaku 5 ne 7 (98.36%, 98.91%) mu busengeke obwo.

Hausa: Kasar Habasha tana da masana'antu masu gurɓata muhalli da yawa, amma galibi ba ta iya magancewa da tsaftace sharar ruwa saboda ƙarancin kuɗaɗe.
Northern Sotho: Ethiopia e na le diintaseteri tše dintši tše di bakago tšhilafatšo, eupša gantši e palelwa ke go hlwekiša le go hlatswa ka tshwanelo meetse a ditšhila ka baka la tlhokego ya thušo ya ditšhelete.
Amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ብዙ መራዥ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ቢኖሯትም አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በገንዘብ እጥረት ምክንያት ቆሻሻ ፍሳሽን በአግባቡ ለማከም እና ለማጽዳት ሳትችል ቀርታለች።

English: In this study, the researchers looked for simple, cheap ways to clean waste from leather- making industries.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonya engeri ennyangu era ezitali za buseere ez’okulongoosa kazambi ava mu makolero agakola amaliba.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí wá ọ̀nà tó rọrùn, àti àwọn ọ̀nà tí kò wọ́n tí wọ́n lè fi tún omi ìdọ̀tí tó ń wá láti iléeṣẹ́ awọ ṣe.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke izindlela ezilula, ezishibhile zokuhlanza udoti ezimbonini zokwenza isikhumba.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun nemi hanyoyi masu sauƙi, masu arha don tsaftace sharar ruwa daga masana'antar fata.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyakana le ditsela tše bonolo, tše di sa nyakego tšhelete ye ntši go hlwekiša ditšhila go tšwa diintasetering tša tšweletšo ya mekgopha.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ ቆዳን ከሚሰሩ ኢንዱስትሪዎች የሚወጣውን ቆሻሻ ለማጽዳት ቀላል እና ርካሽ መንገዶችን ፈልገዋል።

English: They tried pumice, gravel and a grass called Chrysopogon zizanioides, or vetiver.
Luganda: Baagezaako okukozesa pumice, gravel n’omuddo oguyitibwa Chrysopogon zizanioides, oba vetiver.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbìyànjú òkúta ìfọ gìgísẹ̀, òkúta wẹ́wẹ́ àti koríko tí wọ́n ń pè ní Chrysopogon zizanioides, tàbí koríko ẹ̀sún.
Zulu: Bazama impumu, ubhuqu kanye notshani okuthiwa yi-Chrysopogon zizanioides, noma i-vetiver.
Hausa: Sun gwada tsakuwa mai kaushi da tsakuwa da ciyawa da ake kira Doguwar ciyawa ko vetiver.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekile pumice, lekgwara le bjang bjo bo bitšwago Chrysopogon zizanioides, goba vetiver.
Amharic: ቦርቴ ድንጋይ፤ኮረት እና ክሪሶፖጎን ዚዛኒኦድስ ወይም ቬቲቨር የተባለ ሳርን ሞክረዋል።

English: Pumice is a type of soil from mines that people use to improve soil quality and make it hold water better, while vetiver grass has a big root system and can grow up to 5 metres tall.
Luganda: Pumice kika kya ttaka eriva mu birombe abantu lye bakozesa okwongera ku bugimu bw’ettaka n’okulisobozesa okukuuma obulungi amazzi, so ng’omuddo gwa vetiver gulina emirandira emiwanvu egisobola okuweza mmita 5 obuwanvu.
Yoruba: Òkúta ìfọ gìgísẹ̀ jẹ́ irú ilẹ̀ kan láti tí wọ́n ń rí láti máìnì tí àwọn èèyàn fi ń mú ilẹ̀ dára àti láti jẹ́ kó gba omi sára dáada, nígbà tí koríko ẹ̀sún ní gbòǹgbò tí ó gbilẹ̀ tí ó sì lè ga tó mítà 5.
Zulu: Impumu wuhlobo lwenhlabathi ephuma ezimayini abantu abayisebenzisayo ukuthuthukisa izinga lenhlabathi futhi bayenze ibambe amanzi kangcono, kanti utshani be-vetiver bunezimpande ezinkulu futhi bungakhula bube ngamamitha ama-5 ubude.
Hausa: Tsakuwa mai kaushi nau'in ƙasa ce daga ma’adinan da mutane ke amfani da su don inganta yanayin ƙasa da kuma sa ta zama mafi kyau wajen riƙe ruwa, yayin da ciyawar vetiver take da babban tsarin saiwa kuma tana iya girma har zuwa tsawon mita 5.
Northern Sotho: Pumice ke mohuta wa mabu ao a tšwago meepong ao batho ba a šomišago go kaonafatša boleng bja mabu le go dira gore a boloke meetse bokaone, mola bjang bja vetiver bo na le medu ye megolo ebile bo ka mela go fihla botelele bja dimetara tše 5.
Amharic: ቬቲቨር ሲያድግ እስከ 5 ሜትር ሊረዝም የሚችል ትልቅ የስር ስርአት ያለው ሳር ሲሆን ቦርቴ ድንጋይ ደግሞ ከማእድን የሚገኝ ሰዎች የአፈርን ጥራት ለማሻሻል እና ውሃን በተሻለ ሁኔታ እንዲይዝ የሚጠቀሙበት የአፈር አይነት ነው።

English: Gravel is a type of soil made of very small, round stones mixed with sand.
Luganda: Gravel kika kya ttaka eririmu obuyinja obutono ennyo nga bwetooloovu, nga bwetabudde n’omusenyu.
Yoruba: Òkúta wẹ́wẹ́ jẹ́ irúfẹ́ ilẹ̀ tí a fi òkúta roboto kékèèké tí a dà pọ̀ mọ́ erùpẹ̀ ṣẹ̀dá.
Zulu: Ubhuqu wuhlobo lwenhlabathi eyenziwe ngamatshe amancane kakhulu ayindilinga axutshwe nesihlabathi.
Hausa: Tsakuwa nau’i ne na ƙasa da aka yi da ƙananan duwatsu masu zagaye haɗe da yashi.
Northern Sotho: Lekgwara ke mohuta wa mabu ao a nago le maswikana a mannyanenyane, a nkgokolwana ao a hlakanego le santa.
Amharic: ኮረት ከአሸዋ ጋር ከተደባለቁ ትናንሽ ክብ ድንጋዮች የተሰራ የአፈር አይነት ነው።

English: The researchers made two wetlands of their own for the study.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakola entobazi ezaabwe bbiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ méjì lọ́wọ́ ara wọn fún ìwádìí náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benza amaxhaphozi amabili abo ocwaningo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi dausayi guda biyu nasu domin gudanar binciken.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba itlhametše mafelo a monola a mabedi ka bobona go thuša dinyakišišo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለጥናቱ የራሳቸውን ሁለት ረግረግ መሬቶች አዘጋጅተው ነበር።

English: A wetland is an area filled with water and may have some fish and plants in it.
Luganda: Olutobazi kye kifo ekirimu amazzi era nga kisobola okubaamu ebyennyanja n’ebimera.
Yoruba: Ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ ni agbègbè kan tó kún fún omi tó sì lè ní ẹja àti àwọn ewéko nínú rẹ̀.
Zulu: Ixhaphozi yindawo egcwele amanzi futhi ingaba nezinhlanzi nezitshalo kuyo.
Hausa: Dausayi yanki ne mai cike da ruwa kuma yana iya samun kifaye da tsirrai a cikinsa.
Northern Sotho: Lefelo la monola ke lefelo le le nago le meetse moo go ka hwetšwago dihlapi le dimela go lona.
Amharic: ረግረግ መሬት በውሃ የተሞላ አካባቢ ሲሆን በውስጡም ጥቂት አሳዎች እና ተክሎች ሊኖሩት ይችላል።

English: One wetland they filled with gravel and the other with pumice.
Luganda: Olutobazi olumu baalussaamu gravel ate olulala ne balussaamu pumice.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kó òkúta wẹ́wẹ́ sí ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ kan tí wọ́n sì kó (òkúta ìfọ gìgísẹ̀) sí ìkejì.
Zulu: Elinye ixhaphozi baligcwalisa ngamatshe kanti elinye baligcwalisa ngempumu.
Hausa: Sun cika dausayi ɗaya da tsakuwa, ɗayan kuma da tsakuwa mai kaushi.
Northern Sotho: Ba tšhetše lefelo le tee la monola ka lekgwara gomme le lengwe ba tšhela pumice.
Amharic: አንደኛውን ረግረግ መሬት በኮረት ሌላኛውን ደግሞ በቦርቴ ድንጋይ ሞልተውት ነበር።

English: They planted vetiver grass in both wetlands and let it grow for 5 months.
Luganda: Baasimba omuddo gwa vetiver mu ntobazi zombi ne baguleka ne gukula okumala emyezi 5.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gbin koríko ẹ̀sún sí ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ méjèèjì tí wọ́n sì jẹ́ kó hù fún oṣù 5.
Zulu: Batshala utshani be-vetiver kuwo womabili amaxhaphozi babuyeke bukhule izinyanga ezi-5.
Hausa: Sun dasa ciyawar vetiver a cikin wurare masu dausayi kuma suka bar ta ta girma har tsawon watanni 5.
Northern Sotho: Ba bjetše bjang bja vetiver mafelong ka bobedi a monola le go tlogela go bo tlogela dikgwedi tše 5 gore bo mele.
Amharic: በሁለቱም ረግረግ መሬቶች ቬቲቨር ሳርን በመትከል ለ5 ወራት እንዲያድግ አድርገዋል።

English: After the 5 months, they put wastewater from Modjo leather industry, Ethiopia, into the wetlands and recorded results for 2 years.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi 5, bateeka amazzi ga kazambi okuva mu kkolero ly’amaliba ery’e Modjo, Ethiopia, mu ntobazi ne bawandiika ebyavaamu okumala emyaka 2.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn oṣù 5, wọ́n da omi ìdọ̀tí láti iléeṣẹ́ tó ń ṣe awọ Modjo, ní Ethiopia, sínú àwọn ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ tí wọ́n sì ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn èsì fún ọdún 2.
Zulu: Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezi-5, bafaka amanzi angcolile aphuma embonini yesikhumba yakwa-Modjo, e-Ethiopia, ezindaweni ezingamaxhaphozi futhi babhala imiphumela iminyaka emi-2.
Hausa: Bayan watanni 5, sun sanya sharar ruwan daga masana'antar fata ta Modjo, Habasha, cikin wuraren dausayi kuma sun lura da sakamako na tsawon shekaru 2.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga dikgwedi tše 5, ba tšhetše meetse a ditšhila ao a tšwago intasetering ya go tšweletša mekgopha ya Modjo, Ethiopia, ka mafelong a monola gomme ba rekota dipoelo tša mengwaga ye 2.
Amharic: ከ5 ወራት በኋላም በኢትዮጵያ ከሞጆ የቆዳ ኢንዱስትሪ የተወሰደውን ቆሻሻ ፍሳሽ በረግረግ መሬቶቹ ውስጥ በመጨመር ውጤቹን ለ2 አመታት ያህል መዝግበዋል።

English: They specifically looked at the water quality of the wastewater before and after adding it to the pond.
Luganda: Okusinga baatunuulira omutindo gw’amazzi ga kazambi nga tebannagassa mu kidiba n’oluvannyuma lw’okugassaamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo bí dídára omi ìdọ̀tí náà ní pàtó síwájú àti lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n dà á pọ̀ mọ́ omi adágún.
Zulu: Babheke ngokukhethekile izinga lamanzi angcolile ngaphambi nangemuva kokuwangeza echibini.
Hausa: Sun yi la’akari da ingancin ruwan da yake cikin sharar ruwa kafin da kuma bayan ƙarawa a cikin tafki.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba tloga ba lebeletše boleng bja meetse a meetse a ditšhila pele ga le ka morago ga go a tšhollela ka letangwaneng.
Amharic: በተለይም ቆሻሻ ፍሳሹ ወደ ኩሬው ከመጨመሩ በፊት እና በኋላ የነበረውን የውሃ ጥራት ተመልክተዋል።

English: They tested for different nutrients and heavy metals.
Luganda: Baakebera ebirungo eby’enjawulo n’ebyuma ebizito.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìdánwò fún oríṣiríṣi èròǹjà aṣaralóore àti irin tó wúwo.
Zulu: Bahlolele imisoco ehlukene kanye nezinsimbi ezisindayo.
Hausa: Sun gwada abubuwan gina jiki daban-daban da ƙarafa masu nauyi.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile diteko tša dijophepo tša go fapafapana le dimetale tše boima.
Amharic: ለተለያዩ ንጥረ ነገሮች እና ከባድ ብረቶችም ምርመራ አድርገዋል።

English: Heavy metals are metals that are poisonous even at low concentrations.
Luganda: Ebyuma ebizito bye byuma eby’obutwa ne bwe biba nga si bingi.
Yoruba: Àwọn irin tó wúwo jẹ́ irin tó ní májèlé nínú kódà kó má pọ̀.
Zulu: Izinsimbi ezisindayo ziyizinsimbi ezinobuthi ngisho zimumethe kancane.
Hausa: Ƙarafa masu nauyi ƙarafa ne masu guba ko da kaɗan ne.
Northern Sotho: Dimetale tše boima ke dimetae tše di nago le mpholo le ge di na le metswako ya fasana.
Amharic: ከባድ ብረቶች የሚባሉት በዝቅተኛ የክምችት መጠን እንኳ መርዛማ የሆኑ ናቸው።

English: The researchers said the wastewater from the leather industry was very dirty before they put it in their wetlands, with very high concentrations of nutrients and pollutants.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti amazzi ga kazambi agava mu makolero g’amaliba gaali macaafu nnyo nga tebannagateeka mu ntobazi zaabwe, nga galimu ebirungo n’ebicaafuwaza bingi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé omi ìdọ̀tí láti iléeṣẹ́ tó ń ṣe awọ dọ̀tí gidi gan-an kí wọ́n tó fi sí ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀, pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ aṣaralóore àti ohun tó ń fa ìdọ̀tí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi amanzi angcolile aphuma embonini yesikhumba ayengcole kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba bawabeke ezindaweni zabo ezingamaxhaphozi, anenani eliphezulu kakhulu lemisoco kanye nezinto ezingcolisayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ruwan dauɗar da ake samu daga masana'antar fata ya kasance da dauɗa sosai kafin su sanya shi a cikin dausayinsu, mai yawan sinadarin gina jiki da kuma gurɓata yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore meetse a ditšhila a go tšwa intasetering ya tšweletšo ya mekgopha a be a šilafetše kudu pele ba a tšhela mafelong a monola, a be a na le metswako ya godimo kudu ya nutrients le ditšhilafatši.
Amharic: ከቆዳ ኢንዱስትሪው የተወሰደውን የቆሻሻ ፍሳሽ በረግረግ መሬታቸው ውስጥ ከመጨመራቸው በፊት በከፍተኛ መጠን የመርዞች እና ንጥረ ነገሮች ክምችት እጅግ በጣም ቆሻሻ እንደነበረ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: They said the wetland they had filled with pumice cleaned up to 96-99% of the waste, starting from day 5 up to day 7.
Luganda: Baagamba nti olutobazi lwe baateekamu pumice lwaggyamu obucaafu okutuuka ku bitundu 96-99%, okuva ku lunaku 5 okutuuka ku lunaku 7.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ tó kún fún (òkúta ìfọ gìgísẹ̀) sọ ìdá 96-99% ìdọ̀tí náà di mímọ́, tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti ọjọ́ 5 títí dé ọjọ́ 7.
Zulu: Bathe ixhaphozi ababeligcwalisile ngempumu yakhuculula imfucuza yafinyelela ku-96-99%, kusukela osukwini lwesi-5 kuze kube lusuku lwesi-7.
Hausa: Sun ce dausayin da suka cika da tsakuwa mai kaushi sun tsaftace har zuwa kashi 96-99% na sharar, tun daga ranar 5 zuwa rana ta 7.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore lefelo la monola leo ba le tšhetšego pumice le hlwekišitše go fihla go 96-99% tša ditšhila, go tloga ka letšatši la 5 go fihla go letšatši la 7.
Amharic: በቦርቴ ድንጋይ የተሞላው ረግረግ መሬት 96-99% የሚሆነውን ቆሻሻ ከ5ኛው ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ 7ኛው ቀን ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ያጸዳ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል።

English: They said even though the wetland with gravel was also good, it did not clean as much as pumice.
Luganda: Baagamba nti newankubadde olutobazi olwalimu gravel nalwo lwali lulungi, teyalongoosa kutuuka ku pumice.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ilẹ̀ àkùrọ̀ tó ní òkúta wẹ́wẹ́ náà dáa, kò mọ́ dáadá tó ti òkúta ìfọ gìgísẹ̀.
Zulu: Bathe noma ixhaphozi elinobhuqu nalo lilihle kodwa alihlanzeki njengepumice.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce duk da cewa dausayin da yake da tsakuwa shi ma yana da kyau, amma bai yi tsafta kamar na tsakuwa mai kaushi ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore le ge lefelo la monola le le tšhetšwego lekgwara e be e le le lebotse, ga se la hlwekiša go swana le la pumice.

Zulu: Bathi utshani be-vetiver buhlanze kangcono uma kusendaweni eyixhaphozi egcwele impumu kunaleyo egcwele amatshe.
